description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M). Single change: qk shape goes (NAP=4, tph=256) -> (NAP=6, tph=64). Param-matched: 6*256*16*128 = 6*64*64*128 = 3.15M/L. Opposite-direction of exp699 (which tested NAP=3,tph=512 wide and lost). Deep version: K=64 rows per table, only 64 tables. Bandwidth: 192 KB/L per layer (4x less than exp696's 768 KB/L). Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M (NAP=4,tph=256), exp699 (killed step 4000)=1.5164 was +5.7 mb behind, exp698 (NAP=3,tph=256, smaller)=1.4510 at step 6600.
